notes: Digging 10 a tile. Pop 200, 300, 400 or 500 the deeper it is. A dragon popped sideways scores double.
A lunchbox dropped on 1 to 8 scores 1,000 to 15,000. Extra life at 10,000, 40,000 and every 40,000.

victories: drop one lunchbox on two at once.
